Boxed-warning sentence verbatim in label and ODMemo. Organ/direction match; FDA reviews never cite renal hypouricemia (grep), so pairing is the drafter's. Double-counting with dose 2 raised as rule question.
Ahn 2016 JPET (PMID 26907620, epub Feb 2016) abstract has the quote verbatim; capuchin FEUA up, plasma urate down. UR-1102 = epaminurad (Jun 2025 ref 10). Opening untested at 2013 proxy is allowed.

Lee 2019 (PMID 31056705) abstract quote verbatim; healthy-volunteer sUA fall and dose-dependent FEUA rise match monkey direction. Monkey data published 2016, before human results: prospective, so same not retro. Paired, hatched.
Ahn 2016 abstract quote verbatim; monkey plasma urate lowering is the prediction for sUA, the gout trials' primary endpoint. Year 2013 proxy acceptable.

Jun 2025 (PMID 40420308, PMC12105222) quote verbatim; primary endpoint sUA<0.36 mmol/L wk4 met at all doses. Jun cites Ahn 2016 only in rationale, so paired. Phase 2a results unpublished; 2025 is earliest tier 1-3 comparison.
Ahn 2016 abstract quote verbatim (in vitro hepatotoxicity-mechanism assays vs benzbromarone). ex_vivo is the closest model_kind enum value. Year 2013 proxy allowed.

PMC full text Discussion has the quote verbatim; authors state the match. Note 3 pts on 9 mg vs 1 placebo had ALT/AST >3x ULN (one possibly related), so low confidence is right; same stands as stated by source.

missing: Fleischmann 2014 Rheumatology, lesinurad + febuxostat in gout patients, 100% reached sUA <6 (doi 10.1093/rheumatology/ket487): earlier human PD for the genotype track (engagement).
Zurampic label 2015 sections 12.1-12.2 state hURAT1 IC50 and gout-patient FEUA/sUA side by side: stated comparison for hurat1-cell-urate-uptake track, 2015.

Verinurad: hURAT1 IC50 25 nM (Tan 2017 Sci Rep, doi 10.1038/s41598-017-00706-7) vs sUA lowering in gout patients (phase IIa, doi 10.1136/rmdopen-2017-000584; febuxostat combo doi 10.1136/rmdopen-2018-000647): second member drug on the hURAT1-cell track.

Epaminurad (URC102): hURAT1 inhibitor with healthy-volunteer sUA lowering (doi 10.1093/rheumatology/kez140) and phase 2b gout trial meeting sUA <0.36 mmol/L primary (doi 10.1186/s13075-025-03577-w): third member drug on the hURAT1-cell / efficacy track.

Other model systems exist but no member-drug patient comparison found: tufted capuchin monkey uricosuric model (UR-1102, PMID 26907620, non-member) and hURAT1 knock-in mouse (PMID 39740040, 2024-25, would be retrodiction for lesinurad).
Not verified: whether verinurad or D-0120 gout programmes reported renal adverse events (safety track) or discontinuation for failure; no press release or SEC search done within budget.
rule_questions: Dose 2: rats and monkeys carry uricase, so they could not show urate nephropathy; their kidney NOAEL concerned a different lesion. Does a stated margin for a harm the species cannot show count as margin_stated (dose contra) or as model silence (no miss, dose untested)?
Renal failure is scored in dose (tox track, contra) and again in safety (genotype track, same). Does 'count the harm once' apply across different tracks, or only within one model system?

Safety 2 pairs a genotype no sponsor or regulator used as a safety model; does check rule 4 ('the system the class relied on') bar such a track, or does the drafter brief's 'every model system compared with patients' admit it?
